name: Retired .NET Core target framework
description: Flags projects that target retired .NET Core 1.x, 2.x, 3.0, or 3.1 target framework monikers.
impact: Retired .NET Core runtimes no longer receive standard support and can block safe modernization sequencing.
evidenceRequirements: Project target framework metadata must be available from extracted project facts.
recommendedActions: Plan migration to a supported .NET target and review package constraints before changing the target framework.
